item.title: District 17 Primary Decided
item.description: Adam Collins -- Voters in District 17 turned out Tuesday for the only primary race on the Door Peninsula, narrowing the field in the contest for a seat on the Door County Board.

item.title: Yoga, Meditation and More Highlight YMCA Winter 2 Lineup
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County YMCA is wrapping up its Winter 1 session and preparing to launch Winter 2 classes beginning Monday, Feb. 23.

item.title: WHS Announces August Date for 2026 Pet Walk, Registration Open
item.description: Adam Collins -- Animal lovers across Door County are invited to register now for the 2026 Pet Walk, an annual fundraiser supporting the lifesaving work of the Wisconsin Humane Society.

item.title: Spud Run Expands Fresh Food Access to Door County Pantries
item.description: Adam Collins -- A new regional partnership is strengthening food security in Door County by delivering affordable, locally grown potatoes, and other produce, directly to area food pantries.

item.title: Temporary Boardwalk Closure Planned at Sister Bay Marina
item.description: Adam Collins -- Reconstruction work will begin in late February on the main wooden boardwalk between Piers D and J at the Sister Bay Marina, prompting a temporary closure of that section of the waterfront through the end of March.

item.title: Nicolet National Bank completes merger with MidWestOne Financial Group
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- You will soon see the familiar shades of Nicolet National Bank's green and white in Iowa.

item.title: Sheriff’s Department warns of DoorDash driver scam
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The Door County Sheriff's Department is urging extra caution for anyone delivering food for DoorDash.

item.title: Jacque bill would require AI data centers to “says hi to your folks" first
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- State Sen. Andre Jacque wants developers of AI data centers to spend more than a Manitowoc Minute discussing their plans with local communities.

item.title: Door County Medical Center Auxiliary raises $115,000 for Angel Scholarship
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The future of medicine in Door County is a little brighter thanks to your generosity.

item.title: Kitchens disappointed in Evers’ final State of the State address
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- After previously praising Gov. Tony Evers for his willingness to meet more often and compromise with Republican leaders, state Rep. Joel Kitchens left the Wisconsin State Capitol on Tuesday with a sour taste in his mouth.
